tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000260 ༄༅// rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris dge/

rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi 'khor lo shin tu zab pa/ steng 'khor kher rkyang gi srung ba kha sbyar ba'i rang srung dang*/ sri'u srung bar dbyug par btags nas brdung ba/ 'og 'khor liṅga bri nas mnan pa sogs rnam grangs mang yang*/ rtsa ba gter byon yin pa tsam las bar skabs nas shangs pa/ sa dge sogs gsar ma ba'i nyams bzhes su song nas/ snga 'gyur la dar so chung gshis 'khor lo rnams kyang sku mtshams dam drags pas sna tshogs snang yang*/ 'dir gsal ba gter gzhung dgongs don ltar za hor sngags smyon gyis bkod pa/ sngags rgan ral pa can tshos dpyad par zhu// lcags zam lugs kyi rgyun la mo 'khor lugs 'di ltar 'dug kyang*/ zur chen phyag bris mar rtsibs mchan la rak+ṣa sa ma ya dzaḥtshar re dang*/ lte bar tri 'dug go/ lcags zam phyogs kyi rgyun la pho 'khor 'di ltar snang zhing*/ zur chen gyi phyag bris la rtsibs mchan la bh+yo ma gtogs gzhan mi snang ngo*// ༈ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi 'khor lo 'di la/ steng 'khor kher rkyang la brten pa'i srung ba/ sngags mgo gtod phyogs bsgyur ba'i zlog pa/ gdon tshabs che na steng 'og kha sbyar nas rang dang sri'u gso ba/ bdag gzhan srung ba/ 'khor lo dbyug pa la btags nas 'dre brdung ba/ 'og 'khor gyi lte bar rgyal chen sogs gnod byed kyi liṅga bris te mnan sreg sogs 'og 'khor rkyang pa'i las sbyor/ au ḍī yā na'i a tsar+ya de'i bzhed par za hor gyi sngags smyon gyi go ba tshad ldan yin min gsang chen rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyis dpyad par zhu/ bar skabs su gsar ma'i bla brang tshor sku mtshams la bzhugs nas dbu nyug nyug tsam yang mi 'dug go/
